english.title: Online marketplace operator fail to maintain and retain record of packaging waste - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a producer of packaging waste who was an online marketplace operator, failed to maintain for each data collection period, and retain for at least 7 years after the end of that data collection period, records of information referred to in paragraphs 17(a), 17(b), 20(a) or 20(c) of Schedule 1 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(4) and 28(2)(a) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
